entries.title: A check your first mate starts carries only your words for it
entries.body: When your first mate starts a check or another step on its own, the crewmate no longer reads your words about other work as its ask, such as a request to merge a different task without asking. Its instructions say you gave no words for it and its goal stands in. When the step belongs under a task you gave standing permission on, it sees that permission labeled as belonging to that task, and your first mate passes your words on to each step they cover.
entries.noPicture: This changes what a crewmate is told when it starts, not how any view looks.
